def count_words(text: str) -> int:
    """Count words in a note, ignoring comment lines (first non-blank char is '#')."""
    return sum(
        len(line.split())
        for line in text.splitlines()
        if not line.lstrip().startswith('#')
    )
E
cat >> tests/test_wordcount.py <<'E'


def test_count_words_skips_indented_comment_lines():
    assert count_words('   \t# note here\nhello\n') == 1


def test_count_words_hash_mid_line_is_not_a_comment():
    assert count_words('hello # world\n') == 3


def test_count_words_splits_on_any_whitespace_run():
    assert count_words('a  b\tc \t d\n\n  e') == 5


def test_count_words_empty_and_comment_only():
    assert count_words('') == 0
    assert count_words('# a\n  # b c') == 0
E
